data.narrative:
Alto Neuroscience, a public-stage biotech company founded by Amit Etkin, has raised $253M to date and carries a current valuation of $1.04B. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 5 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables in Biotech & Health, spanning both public and late-stage private companies.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach. The five peers—Chai Discovery ($3.8B), New Limit ($3.1B), Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Freenome ($1.1B), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M)—yield a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range from $539M to $3.8B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples could not be applied; the sector median P/S for three public biotech tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) is 6.6x, but Alto's revenue is not disclosed, precluding this method.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $1.8B, centered on $1.6B. Alto's current $1.04B valuation sits below this peer-derived median, though within the observable dispersion of the comparable set. Key uncertainties include the stage-mixing within the peer cohort—two comparables remain Series C private companies—and the absence of revenue data, which limits multiples-based corroboration. The peer sample itself is modest (n=5), increasing sensitivity to outlier valuations.
